summary: Added self-learning mode branch guard to orch-gate.sh and orch-gate-bash.sh: after active-claim check passes, fetches task detail via /task/detail?key=TASK_KEY from claim response, checks .task.metric != null, and if metric present verifies git branch starts with orch/attempt/ — blocks with exit 2 and descriptive message if not. Also updated classify.sh to check the active claim's task for a metric spec at UserPromptSubmit time and inject the self-learning mode hint into additionalContext.

subject: Gate: block direct edits in self-learning mode unless worktree is active
description: Modify hooks/orch-gate.sh (and orch-gate-bash.sh): after checking active-claim, call /task/detail on the claimed task. If the task has a metric spec (self-learning mode), also require that git branch = orch/attempt/* (worktree is active). If not in worktree, block with message: "task has a metric spec — call branch_task first to enter self-learning mode". Classifier should also detect metric-spec tasks and inject a reminder to follow the loop.
